annotations.title: One site's maintenance windows: on now, scheduled, and the last 30 days

description: Wraps GET /api/sites/{slug}/maintenance. One site's maintenance windows: on now, scheduled, and the last 30 days. Call this to see whether a site is in a maintenance window (its alerts held, its uptime not counting that time) and when the next one is. Windows are started from the dashboard or a deploy calling the site's maintenance URL (POST <url>/start?minutes=30, POST <url>/end), which the dashboard shows to admins.
name: sites_by_slug_maintenance

endedBy.description: who ended it early; null when it ran its course

endsAt.description: at most 24 hours after startsAt; an early end shows here

reason.description: the team's own words; never on the public page

scope.description: this site only, or every site in its project

state.description: not started yet, on now, or over

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call
